WITH daily_hours AS (
    SELECT pickup_date,
           pickup_dow,
           COUNT(DISTINCT pickup_hour) AS hours_covered
    FROM investigator.trips
    WHERE pickup_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-07-31'
      AND is_valid_trip
    GROUP BY pickup_date, pickup_dow
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT t.pickup_date,
           t.pickup_dow,
           t.pickup_hour,
           COUNT(*) AS hourly_trips
    FROM investigator.trips t
    WHERE t.pickup_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-07-31'
      AND t.is_valid_trip
    GROUP BY t.pickup_date, t.pickup_dow, t.pickup_hour
),
avg_hourly AS (
    SELECT pickup_dow,
           ROUND(AVG(hourly_trips),1) AS avg_trips_per_hour,
           MIN(hourly_trips) AS min_hourly_trips,
           MAX(hourly_trips) AS max_hourly_trips,
           COUNT(DISTINCT pickup_date) AS days_per_dow
    FROM normalized
    GROUP BY pickup_dow
)
SELECT ah.pickup_dow,
       ah.avg_trips_per_hour,
       ah.min_hourly_trips,
       ah.max_hourly_trips,
       ah.days_per_dow,
       dh.hours_covered
FROM avg_hourly ah
LEFT JOIN daily_hours dh ON ah.pickup_dow = dh.pickup_date
ORDER BY ah.pickup_dow
